mapper.sql: id, goods_id, `day`, tier, score, suggested_deal_price, reasons, status, add_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: insert into litemall_deal_candidate (goods_id, `day`, tier, score, suggested_deal_price, reasons, status, add_time, update_time, deleted) values (#{goodsId}, #{day}, #{tier}, coalesce(#{score}, 0.00), #{suggestedDealPrice}, #{reasons}, coalesce(#{status}, 'proposed'), now(), now(), 0) on duplicate key update tier = if(status = 'proposed', values(tier), tier), score = if(status = 'proposed', values(score), score), suggested_deal_price = if(status = 'proposed', values(suggested_deal_price), suggested_deal_price), reasons = if(status = 'proposed', values(reasons), reasons), update_time = if(status = 'proposed', now(), update_time)
mapper.select: select from litemall_deal_candidate where `day` = #{day} and deleted = 0 and status = #{status} order by score desc, id asc
select from litemall_deal_candidate where goods_id = #{goodsId} and deleted = 0 order by `day` desc limit 1
select from litemall_deal_candidate where goods_id = #{goodsId} and `day` = #{day} and deleted = 0
mapper.update: update litemall_deal_candidate set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = #{expect} and deleted = 0
